comment: The frequency ranges are literals in the source: VCO coarse 15Hz to 1000Hz, LFO coarse 0.15Hz to 10Hz, and both fine ranges a twelfth of a semitone either side of C0 at 16.352Hz (src/Sena.cpp:210-221). Linear FM adds 120 times the input voltage in hertz and is DC blocked. Switching a channel to fine tuning resets its frequency knob to the middle of that range (src/Sena.cpp:525-528), which is a real jump in pitch and is not documented by the maker. The channel 4 mod input behaves differently from the other three: the PWM knob scales the incoming CV rather than offsetting it (src/Sena.cpp:586-587). sumRange on the mod inputs is written as a voltage range because the field takes only those four spellings; the quantity clamped is the 0-to-1 shaping amount. The noise generators use random::normal rather than a bounded uniform, so their peaks are not hard limited.
